summary:
Completed Phase 5 for permission-service. Added the shared-preset `renovate.json`, trusted-main weekly/manual dependency-submission workflow, repository dependency-automation documentation, and README link. The workflow preflights the exact `spring-platform` and `service-web` artifacts, uses basic caching, and separates package-read credentials from the submission token. No dependency pins, build configuration, or service code changed.

Validation passed under Node 24: strict Renovate schema validation, actionlint, link and diff checks, and complete-worktree Renovate extraction. Renovate found 45 occurrences across Gradle, wrapper, Dockerfile, and Actions managers, including all three internal catalog coordinates; credential-free lookups produced 45 candidate branches with only authenticated GitHub/private-Maven checks pending.

The official local graph generator ran successfully but produced only 87 build/tool coordinates and no internal or application runtime/test dependencies because authenticated `serviceCommon` 0.0.16 resolution was unavailable. Published-preset resolution, authenticated Renovate lookups, complete hosted graph submission, bot-PR CI, and Dependabot alert evidence remain pending Phase 12 as documented in `docs/dependency-automation.md`.
